name: FAQ, ledger
description: Numbered questions on hairline rows with a margin rule, like a ledger page. Each row opens with a plus that turns.

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: Plain answers on fees, deadlines and what we need from you. If yours is not in the book, the first call with Alder & Finch is free.

itemFields.name: question
itemFields.label: Question
itemFields.default: Do you help with VAT registration?

itemFields.name: answer
itemFields.label: Answer
itemFields.default: Yes. We register you, choose the right scheme and file every quarterly return.

default.question: What do you charge?
default.answer: A fixed monthly fee, agreed before we start. Sole traders pay from £45 a month and limited companies from £120, with year-end accounts and tax returns included.

default.question: Can you take over from my current accountant?
default.answer: Yes. We write to them for your records, which usually takes about two weeks. You do not have to make the awkward phone call.

default.question: Which bookkeeping software do I need?
default.answer: We work in Xero, FreeAgent and QuickBooks. If you have none, a FreeAgent licence is included in your fee and we connect it to your bank.

default.question: What happens if HMRC writes to me?
default.answer: Send us a photo of the letter the same day. Replying to routine letters is part of your fee, and every plan covers the cost of a full enquiry.

default.question: How late can I leave my tax return?
default.answer: Get your records to us by 30 November and we guarantee to file before the 31 January deadline. After that we still try, but we cannot promise.

default.question: Do I have to come to the office?
default.answer: No. Most clients meet us by video twice a year. If you prefer paper and a proper cup of tea, we are above the bakery on Castle Street, Shrewsbury.
